children: Rescue and recovery operations are continuing in Nepal after a glacial collapse triggered catastrophic flooding near the border with China, killing more than 600 people and leaving thousands missing, according to Bloomberg.
Destroyed roads and bridges are complicating efforts to reach isolated communities as Nepal seeks specialized international assistance for tunnel rescues, victim identification and recovery.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Nepal Rescue Efforts Continue After Glacial Collapse
